title: RecoveryJob
description: The physical recovery of a vehicle from the roadside, from the moment it is created out of a failed roadside attempt to the moment the vehicle is off the road. Held in the eVault of the organisation that issues it, because the job has to exist and be matched before an assignee is known; the assigned company is granted update permission on it once it accepts. The requirements block carries the same field names as RoadsideAttempt.recoveryRequirements, so what was observed on site becomes what is matched on without being re-entered.

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the issuing organisation eVault

issuerEName.description: eName of the organisation that issued the job and matches it to a recovery company

incidentEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the Incident the vehicle is recovered for

vehicleEName.description: eName of the vehicle to recover

roadsideAttemptEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the RoadsideAttempt the requirements were taken from, where there was one

requirements.description: Derived from the case, not from manual entry

weightKg.description: Weight of the vehicle, load included, in kilograms

widthMm.description: Overall width in millimetres, without mirrors

dimensions.description: Size of the vehicle, in millimetres

drivetrain.description: Drivetrain of the vehicle. It decides how the vehicle may be towed and stored.

wheelsTurn.description: Whether all wheels still turn freely

winchable.description: Whether the vehicle can be winched onto a flatbed

towingMethod.description: The towing method the vehicle needs

equipmentNeeded.description: Equipment the recovery must bring, such as dollies or a crane

certificationsRequired.description: Certifications the recovery crew must hold, such as for high-voltage electric vehicles

accessConstraints.description: What makes the vehicle hard to reach, such as a ditch, a car park height limit or a narrow road

address.description: Street address of the pick-up, as a person would write it

road.description: Road name or number, such as A2

roadSectionId.description: roadSectionId of the RoadSection the vehicle is on, which decides the Agreements that apply

hazards.description: What makes the location dangerous or hard to work at, using the hazard names of Incident.location.hazards

pickupLocation.description: Where the vehicle is to be collected

destination.description: Where the vehicle is taken off the road to. A depot stop is a legitimate destination and is not the same as the garage.

locationEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the ServiceLocation the vehicle is taken to

destinationType.description: What kind of place the vehicle is taken to

address.description: Street address of the destination, as a person would write it

deadlineAt.description: Latest time the vehicle must be off the road, such as a clearance deadline set by the road authority

responseTimeObligationMinutes.description: Attached to the road section by an Agreement, or set as a clearance deadline by an EmergencyResponse. A hard requirement, not a preference.

applicableAgreementEnvelopeIds.description: The contracts the matching had to apply: which company may work on this road section, exclusivity, and the own-fleet-first rule

assignedCompanyEName.description: eName of the recovery company that accepted the job

assignedAssetEName.description: eName of the specific truck, not just the company: a Vehicle whose eVault also holds a ServiceVehicle profile with serviceRole recovery

assignedOperatorEName.description: The named operator who performs the recovery and signs for it

matchRanking.description: Why each candidate ranked where it did, so a planner can trust the result and override it with a reason

candidateEName.description: eName of the recovery company that was ranked

rank.description: Place in the ranking, 1 being the best match

score.description: Score the matching gave the candidate. Higher is better.

reasons.description: Why the candidate got its place, one reason per entry, in words a planner can read

overrideReason.description: Set when a planner picks other than the top-ranked candidate

status.description: Where the job stands. Every change also writes a CaseEvent.

declineReason.description: Why the offered company declined the job

offeredAt.description: When the job was offered to a company

acceptedAt.description: When the company accepted the job

enRouteAt.description: When the truck set off to the vehicle

onSceneAt.description: When the truck arrived at the vehicle

completedAt.description: When the vehicle was delivered at its destination

conditionReportEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the ConditionReport written when the vehicle was picked up

handoverReceiptEnvelopeIds.description: MetaEnvelope ids of the HandoverReceipts signed under this job

costRecordEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the record of what this job cost. The ontology for that record is not proposed yet.

authorisationEnvelopeId.description: The insurer decision. The vehicle should not move before the money is agreed.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
